maistro.container.Container.schedule_adm.reason: The seam #231 exists to have the live Hive scheduler build against, not yet a consumed dependency: the migration is blocked on maistro.runs.consumption's deliberate single-node-Run scope (#44/#34), since Hive's bundled daily-status DAG is multi-node and a straight swap today would leave firings QUEUED forever.
